[romanized](/wiki/Romanization_of_Russian "Romanization of Russian"):  _Glava

Саха Өрөспγγбγлγкэтин Ил Дархана; Ил Дархан, romanized:  _Saxa
Öröspüübülüketin İl Darxana; İl Darxan_) is the highest office in the [Sakha
Republic](/wiki/Sakha_Republic "Sakha Republic"). The term of office is five
years.

## History

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Head_of_the_Sakha_Republic&action=edit&section=1
"Edit section: History")]

The office was first introduced in 1991. Before April 2014 it was known as the
**President of the Sakha Republic**.

The first presidential elections in Yakutia were on 20 December 1991. Yakutia
inherited the Soviet electoral system with no real multi-party system to be
established. There were only two candidates in the election. The chairman of
the Supreme Soviet of the Yakut ASSR Mikhail Nikolayev won with 76.7% of the
vote. Nikolayev was reelected in 1996 and succeeded by his former vice
president Vyacheslav Shtyrov in January 2002. Five years later Shtyrov's
appointment for second term which was proposed by President [Vladimir
Putin](/wiki/Vladimir_Putin "Vladimir Putin") was approved by the State
Assembly of Yakutia. After his resignation in May 2010 President of Russia
[Dmitry Medvedev](/wiki/Dmitry_Medvedev "Dmitry Medvedev") appointed prime
minister of the region Yegor Borisov as acting president. He was inaugurated
on 17 June 2010. Since the beginning of Borisov's second term in 2014 the
President of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) became known as the _Head of the
Republic_.

**Aysen Sergeyevich Nikolayev**[a] (born 22 January 1972) is a Russian
politician who has served as the fourth [Head of the Sakha
Republic](/wiki/Head_of_the_Sakha_Republic "Head of the Sakha Republic") since
2018.[1]

## Early life

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Aysen_Nikolayev&action=edit&section=1 "Edit
section: Early life")]

Nikolayev was born in 1972 in [Leningrad](/wiki/Leningrad "Leningrad"), to a
family of teachers. He has two brothers and a sister.[2]

At the age of 16, he graduated from the
[Verkhnevilyuysk](/wiki/Verkhnevilyuysk "Verkhnevilyuysk") Physics and
Mathematics School with a gold medal. Nikolayev entered the [MSU Faculty of
Physics](/wiki/MSU_Faculty_of_Physics "MSU Faculty of Physics") at the [Moscow
State University](/wiki/Moscow_State_University "Moscow State University"). In
1994 he graduated, and in the same year he graduated from the [Russian
Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public
Administration](/wiki/Russian_Presidential_Academy_of_National_Economy_and_Public_Administration
"Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration")
with a degree in [Financial Management](/wiki/Financial_Management "Financial
Management").[3]

## Political career

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Aysen_Nikolayev&action=edit&section=2 "Edit
section: Political career")]

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ea/Inauguration_of_Aysen_Nikolayev_%282018-09-27%29_06.jpg/330px-
Inauguration_of_Aysen_Nikolayev_%282018-09-27%29_06.jpg)](/wiki/File:Inauguration_of_Aysen_Nikolayev_\(2018-09-27\)_06.jpg)Inauguration
of Aysen Nikolayev as the Head of the Sakha Republic (September 2018)

From 1994 to 1995 he headed [AOZT](/wiki/CJSC "CJSC") SAPI Center. In 1995,
Nikolayev became a member of the board of the open joint-stock company
Almazergienbank, a commercial bank based in [Yakutsk](/wiki/Yakutsk
"Yakutsk"). From 1995 to 1998, he was the deputy chairman of the board of the
bank.[4] From 1997 to 2002, he was a deputy of the second convocation of the
upper chamber of the [State Assembly of the Sakha
Republic](/wiki/State_Assembly_of_the_Sakha_Republic "State Assembly of the
Sakha Republic") from the [Olenyoksky District](/wiki/Olenyoksky_District
"Olenyoksky District").

From 1998 to 2003, he was the chairman of the board of Almazergienbank, as
well as the vice president of LLC FK SAPI. On 2002, he was appointed as a
deputy of the 3rd convocation of the State Assembly of Yakutia from the [Union
of Right Forces](/wiki/Union_of_Right_Forces "Union of Right Forces") party,
till 2004. On 2004, he was elected as the Minister of Finance of Yakutia.
Nikolayev become the head of the Presidential Administration and Government of
Yakutia in 2007. On 18 May 2011, he was appointed First Deputy Chairman of the
Government of Yakutia.[5]

At the beginning of December 2011, the Yakutsk City Duma appointed the mayoral
elections six months earlier - simultaneously with the presidential elections
on 4 March 2012, and then on 23 December 2011, Yakutsk Mayor Yuri Zabolev
resigned. In January 2012, Aysen Nikolayev was nominated by the [United
Russia](/wiki/United_Russia "United Russia") party as a candidate for the
mayoral elections in Yakutsk. In the elections held on 4 March 2012, Nikolaev
received 47.73% of the votes with a turnout of 69.84%. According to the
results of the vote, he was elected head of the administration of the city
district of Yakutsk for 5 years.[6][7]

In the spring of 2017, prior to the appointment of the next elections for the
mayor of Yakutsk, the Yakut branch of the United Russia party held primaries
of candidates for the election of the head of Yakutsk, in which Nikolayev
scored 86%. In the summer of 2017, he was again nominated as a candidate for
mayor of Yakutsk. In the [2017 Russian elections](/wiki/2017_Russian_elections
"2017 Russian elections"), he received 68.4% of the vote and was elected for a
second term.[8]

### Head of the Sakha Republic

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Aysen_Nikolayev&action=edit&section=3 "Edit
section: Head of the Sakha Republic")]

On 28 May 2018, by the [Decree of the President of
Russia](/wiki/Decree_of_the_President_of_Russia "Decree of the President of
Russia") [Vladimir Putin](/wiki/Vladimir_Putin "Vladimir Putin"), Nikolayev
was appointed as the acting [Head of the Sakha
Republic](/wiki/Head_of_the_Sakha_Republic "Head of the Sakha Republic"). On
the [2018 Russian elections](/wiki/2018_Russian_elections "2018 Russian
elections"), he was elected the Head of the Sakha Republic, gaining 71.40% of
the votes cast in the elections. On 27 September 2018, he took office as Head
of the Sakha Republic.[9][10]

From 2 August 2019 to 27 January 2020, he was the member of the Presidium of
the [State Council of the Russian Federation](/wiki/State_Council_\(Russia\)
"State Council \(Russia\)").[11]

He was re-elected in 2023.

## Sanctions

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Aysen_Nikolayev&action=edit&section=4 "Edit
section: Sanctions")]

Since July 2022, against the backdrop of the [Russian invasion of
Ukraine](/wiki/Russian_invasion_of_Ukraine "Russian invasion of Ukraine"), he
has been under sanctions of the British government because he "manages a
regional state body of the Russian Federation, which supports or implements
actions or policies that undermine or threaten the territorial integrity,
sovereignty and independence of Ukraine."[12][13] In December 2022, the
[Office of Foreign Assets Control](/wiki/Office_of_Foreign_Assets_Control
"Office of Foreign Assets Control") of the [United States Department of the
Treasury](/wiki/United_States_Department_of_the_Treasury "United States
Department of the Treasury") added Nikolayev and 28 other governors of the
[federal subjects of Russia](/wiki/Federal_subjects_of_Russia "Federal
subjects of Russia") to the [Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked
Persons List](/wiki/Specially_Designated_Nationals_and_Blocked_Persons_List
"Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List") due to their
involvement in the enforcement of the conscription of Russian citizens in
response to the [mobilization order](/wiki/2022_Russian_mobilization "2022
Russian mobilization") in September 2022.[14] Nikolayev is also sanctioned by
[Canada](/wiki/Canada "Canada") and [Ukraine](/wiki/Ukraine
"Ukraine").[15][16]

## Personal life

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Aysen_Nikolayev&action=edit&section=5 "Edit
section: Personal life")]

Nikolayev is married to Lyudmila Valerievna Nikolayeva. She has worked in
executive positions in diamond mining companies since 2005. They have three
children.[17][18]

Since 2010. Nikolayev has also served as the President of the
[Equestrian](/wiki/Equestrianism "Equestrianism") Federation of the Republic
of Sakha.[19] He is also the member of the Political Council of the regional
branch of United Russia.[20]
